decision: Full car = 'GR Corolla Full Car.stl' (17j3c0hl..., 16.7M tris, 2025-05-19), decimated 4 mm (wide) / 2 mm (close-ups), ground cropped, prepped -> car4.json = canonical frame; every other scan prepped with --like car4.json
why: Suggested in the brief, newest complete capture; 4,397 mm long after crop (Toyota lists ~4,410 mm). Front Clip (16M) is a crop of this same capture (1.33 mm, 0 correction) so it adds nothing

decision: Registration (tools/regcheck.py + red-over-grey Blender renders /home/user/media/work/grc/chk/reg.jpg): used at identity: rear bumper outer 1.9 mm, inner side 2.9, diffuser 3.0, diffuser removed 1.9, rear bumper removed 2.2, crash bar removed 3.0, rear 1.9, hatch-open states 2.0, 2023 front 'Bumper (1.2m)' 3.6, Chassis Stripped 2.0. NOT used (other frames): Mirror, Car No Mirror, Core Hood Underside, Facelift Front Only, Engine Bay Stripped, beams/ducts, ARA Rear Crash Beam
why: Same-frame scans sit 2-4 mm from the car with trial ICP not improving the median (sliding along the skin); the others have <5 % overlap or need 40-140 mm corrections, i.e. they were captured in their own frames and can't be pinned to the car without a risky global registration

decision: Rear wheels filled from 'GR Corolla rear' state scan: only its triangles inside the two rear-wheel boxes and >6 mm from the car (tools/wheelfill.py, +85k tris) -> car4w/car2w, prepped --like car4.json
why: The full-car capture has no rear wheels (2.5k pts per rear-wheel zone vs 7-11k at the front). The rear state scan (same frame) has the real left-rear wheel and part of the right-rear; smallest-zone splice per lessons. Right-rear stays partial, so rear views favour the car's left side and front views its right

decision: Exploded view base = full car with hood, fenders, 4 doors, hatch cut out at their seams + 'GR Corolla Chassis Stripped' (registered, 2.0 mm) where it adds structure; panels = real part scans (front 'Bumper (1.2m)', rear bumper outer + inner side, diffuser) + the cut skins (tools/panels.py, seams read from mm-grid splats chk/grid_side.png, grid_top.png)
why: Brief: build from part scans + removed-state scans. Only bumpers/diffuser exist as separate scans; the stripped chassis is the 'everything removed' state, so lifting a panel reveals the real scanned shell + roll cage underneath. Car-minus-chassis wasn't usable as a split (the stripped shell's outer skin differs almost everywhere), so panels are cut at seams. Checked red/colour-coded at home and exploded (chk/panels.jpg)

decision: Hood opens 62 deg on its rear hinge (pivot y -0.99 m, z 0.98 m from the hood's rear edge) over the stripped-shell base; hatch opens 75 deg on its top hinge (y 1.32, z 1.36) with the cargo area filled from the 'trunk open (removed)' state scan (tools/cargofill.py, z<620 raw so its propped hatch is dropped)
why: Brief: hood/trunk open where state scans allow. Chassis Stripped gives the real front structure under the hood; the trunk-open state gives the cargo area. No hood-underside scan in this frame (Core Hood Underside is in its own frame), so the hood's inner face is its own skin

decision: Shots: s1 front-right 3/4 turntable, s2 rear-left 3/4 orbit, s3 front-right wheel close-up (2 mm), s4 headlight/grille slide (2 mm), s5 hood opens, s6 hatch opens, s7 rise to top-down, s8 exploded view (separate, orbit front-right -> over -> rear-left, reassemble, lock), logo card; no text, no IRL
why: Temerario order from the brief/reference README; sides chosen so every visible wheel is real scan data

decision: Explode framing: doors/fenders stacked up (0.45-0.85 m) and only 0.6-0.7 m out, bumpers down/out 0.7 m, orbit radius 6.6 m swelling to 8.3 m side-on
why: First pass at 7 m had the car small; 6.3 m pushed panels out of the 9:16 width side-on (chk/frames4.jpg). Ferrari lesson: swell radius side-on; parts never fly at the lens

decision: Music = toyota-gr-corolla_track.mp3 (generated for this reel by the coordinating session, hyperpop-electro). Measured 140.0 BPM (ive beats said 69.8 = half-time), grid anchored on 40-120 Hz kick peaks (t0 0.0825, p90 residual 5.6 ms); no-kick build 0-13.8, drop 13.798, break 26.66-27.08, drop 2 27.513, last kick 37.37, -30 dB at 38.19 -> video ends 38.2 s
why: Lesson: anchor on kick peaks, not first onsets; measure where a generated track really ends (40.0 s file, music over by ~38.2)

decision: Cuts on 8/4-beat phrase lines: s1 0-6.94 (16 beats of build), s2 -10.369, s3 wheel -12.083, s4 nose -13.798 (2x4 beats of close-ups into the drop), s5 hood ON the drop -17.226 (hood lifts b33-b36), s6 hatch -20.655, s7 top-down -24.084, s8 explode -34.370 (assembled orbit through the break, panels separate ON drop 2 27.513, lock 32.656, hold 4 beats), logo 34.370-38.2 over the last phrase and tail
why: Build has no kicks, so the slow turntables live there (Temerario-slow) and the close-ups tighten the pace into the drop; the two drops carry the two transformations (hood opening, panels separating). Whole-frame durs, first clip one frame short (lessons)

decision: v1 review: s8 explode frames 142-155 rendered dark (transient Cycles persistent-data glitch; same frames re-render lit). Re-rendered s8 with a tighter camera (x0.74 radius) on the assembled car through the break that pulls back over 2 beats as panels separate on drop 2
why: Car read small in the 3.4 s pre-separation orbit (v1 strip at 24.1-27.5 s); dark frames would have been a visible flash before the logo. Every render now gets a per-frame brightness check

decision: v2 delivered: explode tail (frames 125-155) re-rendered as stills after the animation render blacked out again from frame 134; brightness continuous across the splice
why: Cycles persistent-data animation render went dark deterministically after all parts locked; single-frame renders are correct. Logged for the next agent

decision: Exploded view rebuilt to the new standing rule: only the front bumper ('Bumper (1.2m)'), rear bumper (outer + inner side) and diffuser come off - each was physically removed and has its own scan + a removed-state scan. Base = full car with those zones trimmed and filled from 'rear bumper removed', 'diffuser removed' and 'Chassis Stripped' as captured (ferrari-296/tools/composite.py -> xbase). Parts float up over the nose/tail; orbit radius 5.6 m head-on swelling to 8.6 m side-on
why: Lesson promoted from the Civic EK reel during this edit: don't show a part coming off unless it was physically removed AND scanned separately. Hood/fender/door/hatch skins cut from the full car have no separate scans, so they stay on. Bumpers moving along the length flew into the lens head-on and out of the 9:16 width side-on (chk/frames7-9)
